### 雾蓝界面更新 / Blue UI refresh

- 整体改为雾蓝主色、深蓝导航与浅蓝列表，统一浅色/深色主题、菜单、设置、文件柜及独立工具窗口的视觉风格。
- 调整列表宽度、头像、字号、消息间距、图标比例与按钮对齐；头像预设采用柔和底色与深色文字，保留原有编号、色系和自定义图片。
- 输入框改用简短占位提示，发送快捷键说明独立放到底部并随设置即时变化；完整保留表情、PK、震动、截图、图片、文件、文件夹和历史搜索入口。
- 已送达状态放到消息下方；文件卡片增强文件名、大小和打开文件夹操作的层次。设置与文件柜采用清晰分组和细分隔线，减少多层卡片。
- A unified blue palette now covers light/dark themes, navigation, menus, settings, file cabinets and utility windows.
- Refined list widths, avatars, typography, message spacing, icon sizing and button alignment. Avatar presets use soft backgrounds with dark lettering while preserving their IDs, hue choices and custom images.
- A concise composer placeholder is paired with a separate footer shortcut hint that updates with the send-key preference. All existing composer tools remain available.
- Delivery status appears below outgoing messages. File cards emphasize filenames, metadata and the folder action; settings and cabinets use simpler sections and separators.

### 验证 / Validation

- Linux 本地通过 138 个测试文件 / 1014 项测试、Electron 22 ABI 数据库自测、类型检查、构建及渲染体积检查、Xvfb 冒烟；版本与双语文档一致性检查通过。
- 在真实 Electron 22 / Chromium 108 中，以隔离演示数据检查私聊、群聊、工具栏、消息菜单、通讯录、文件柜、七组设置与独立工具入口；覆盖浅色/深色、最小窗口和 125% 缩放。
- 发送偏好切换、Enter 换行与 Ctrl+Enter 发送经过交互检查；英文长草稿和文件卡在最小窗口 125% 缩放下无水平溢出。渲染器错误为 0。
- 本轮未在 Windows 7、macOS 真机复测系统字体与窗口边缘，未进行跨机器聊天或文件实发；上述截图与交互检查使用隔离数据。
- Local Linux validation passed 1014 tests in 138 files, Electron ABI database checks, typechecks, build/bundle budgets, Xvfb smoke, and version/documentation consistency checks.
- Actual Electron 22 / Chromium 108 UI checks used isolated fixtures across chats, composer tools, menus, contacts, cabinets, all seven settings sections and utility windows, including both themes, minimum sizes and 125% zoom.
- Send-key preference updates, Enter newlines and Ctrl+Enter sending were exercised. English drafts and file cards fit the minimum window at 125% zoom, with zero renderer errors.
- Windows 7/macOS native font and window-edge checks, and cross-machine chat/file transfers, were not rerun for this visual update.
